verdict.rationale: Highnote exposes a documented GraphQL API covering card issuance, spend controls, ledger, webhooks, and lifecycle operations, plus an official Node.js SDK and a full-parity test environment, enabling programmatic/agentic driving of the product end-to-end. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/schema spec (probe found 404s for standard OpenAPI endpoints) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
